# Pulse 1.0.397

- Keyboard: the automatic correction is about six times faster with the same results; a word left behind while typing goes on is mended in its place and lights up for a moment; a word is mended at the space at once.
- Keyboard: the correction weighs typing cost more against the language model (fewer wrong corrections on real slips).
- Keyboard: turned sideways it has its own height and its own extra-key and number rows (both off until switched on); the settings show both orientations.
- Keyboard: a Samsung look (its bottom row, number row, round toolbar buttons; the tool bar holds the smart fix, emoji, translate, clipboard, settings and more).
- Keyboard clipboard: every new screenshot, camera photo and downloaded picture is taken in, also those made while the keyboard was away; pictures up to 48 MB.
- Music: tag, cover and lyrics edits are written into the song's file (MP3 tags) and show at once; an edited lyric is always read first.
- Poweramp widget: text size, text alignment and the side of the cover; drawn for both sizes Android 12 and later offer, so it no longer shrinks by itself; its page opens from the music settings.
- Icon chooser: the home screen icon comes first (line, or glass in a colour, applied at a tap); the icon inside Pulse folds away.
- Game Hub: the shelf's back to black fixed (the page clears its own black layers after a game; the shelf is made again when it draws nothing).
- Game Hub: consoles drawn as their machines; the disc is taken out and carried in one hold, slides into the console's slot, and the game starts at once; the disc has its own print.
- Game Hub: cover picker inside the shelf ("Find a cover"); "Add a game" is in the shelf's settings; every cover is framed in its console's box; the back of the box shows play statistics and four pictures.
- Local AI: smaller native libraries (one redundant processor build left out; unused code dropped at link).
- Splash picture is WebP (smaller).
